correctness.rationale: For each row, nonnegativity and gamma>=1 give R_i<=w_max A_i^gamma sum_{j!=i} A_j^gamma<=w_max[A_i(B-A_i)]^gamma<=C=w_max(B^2/4)^gamma. A maximum-affinity pair split evenly gives a 2x2 block with Perron root C. Conversely, if the root is C>0, a connected support block attains it; multiplying R_i<=C in that block by its positive left Perron vector forces every row to attain C. Each vertex in that block has area B/2, so there are exactly two, the whole budget is there, and its edge must be a maximum-affinity edge. This includes gamma=1, reducible W, and ties among heaviest edges. For the unit-weight K3, the equal three-site design has root 2(B^2/9)^gamma versus at most (B^2/4)^gamma on any two sites. Thus the strict witness is exactly gamma<log(2)/log(9/4) among positive exponents, without claiming a global transition below one. The frozen checker was inspected rather than executed; the inequality and equality analysis certify all admissible parameters directly.
